body:
Environment

OpenClaw Windows Companion: 2026.10.4-alpha.6

OpenClaw Gateway: 2026.10.4

Windows 11 Home, build 26200

AMD Ryzen 7 5700X, 32 GB RAM

Gateway: WSL2 Ubuntu 24.04

Windows Node: connected and paired

Steps to reproduce

Keep the MXC sandbox enabled.

Execute whoami using exec with host=node.

Do not supply custom environment variables.

Actual result

(Command exited with code -1073741502)

Exit code: 0xC0000142 (STATUS_DLL_INIT_FAILED).

MXC diagnostics

tier: base-container

needsDaclAugmentation: false

isolationSessionAvailable: true

warnings: []

envKeys: []

allowWindowsUi: false

containment: mxc

Execution is approved, but the process exits without stdout or stderr.

Additional findings

The Gateway and Windows Node remain connected.

No reparse points were detected in the examined OpenClawTray directories.

No matching events were found in the Windows Application or CodeIntegrity logs using the tested filters.

Previous version 2026.9.8-1 failed with CreateProcessSecurityEnvironment / 0x800701C0.

Expected result

The sandboxed command whoami should execute successfully without disabling MXC.

Question

Is this a known MXC AppContainer issue on Windows 11 build 26200? Is there a supported fix that preserves sandbox isolation?
